title: Kommunikatör till Kemiska institutionen
description:
Umeå universitet är ett av Sveriges största lärosäten med över 41 500 studenter och cirka 4 600 anställda. Vid universitetet finns en mångfald av utbildningar av hög kvalitet och världsledande forskning inom flera vetenskapsområden, och här gjordes den banbrytande upptäckten av gensaxen CRISPR-Cas9 som tilldelats Nobelpriset i kemi. Vid Umeå universitet är allt nära. Våra sammanhållna campus gör det lätt att mötas, samarbeta och utbyta kunskap, något som gynnar en dynamisk och öppen kultur. Den samhällsomvandling och de stora gröna investeringar vi ser i norra Sverige skapar enorma möjligheter och komplexa utmaningar. För Umeå universitet handlar det om att bedriva forskning om – och mitt i – ett samhälle i omvandling. Men också om att leverera utbildningar för regioner som behöver expandera fort och hållbart. Det är helt enkelt här framtiden skapas. Är du intresserad av att veta mer? Läs mer om Umeå universitet som arbetsplats.

### **Kommunikatör till Kemiska institutionen**

*Är du en nyfiken och initiativrik kommunikatör som vill bidra till att utveckla kommunikationen vid en av universitetets största institutioner? Kemiska institutionen söker dig som vill arbeta både strategiskt och operativt med intern och extern kommunikation. Vi erbjuder ett stimulerande arbete med stort utrymme för kreativitet och utveckling.*

**Arbetsuppgifter**


I din roll som kommunikatör ansvarar du för att samordna, utveckla och kvalitetssäkra institutionens interna och externa kommunikation. Det innebär att du ger kommunikationsstrategiskt stöd till verksamheten och tar fram strategier, riktlinjer och arbetssätt för kommunikationsarbetet. Du ansvarar för att utveckla institutionens kommunikationskanaler, inklusive webb, intranät, digitala skärmar och sociala medier. Du arbetar med att synliggöra och stärka institutionens forskning, utbildning och samverkan genom målgruppsanpassad kommunikation genom att producera och publicera innehåll i olika format, exempelvis webbtexter, nyheter, pressmaterial, sociala medier, foto, film och grafiskt material. Du ska även medverka i utveckling och förvaltning av webbplatser och digitala kommunikationslösningar samt bidra till institutionens profilering, rekrytering och arbetsgivarvarumärke.

**Kvalifikationer**

* Högskoleexamen inom medie- och kommunikationsvetenskap eller motsvarande utbildning.
* Mycket god förmåga att arbeta med text, visuella medier och digitala kanaler, både strategiskt och operativt.
* Vana vid att producera reportage, nyheter och annat redaktionellt innehåll för webb, intranät och sociala medier.
* Goda kunskaper inom foto- och videoproduktion, från planering och produktion till publicering och anpassning för olika kanaler.
* Goda kunskaper i Adobe Creative Cloud, exempelvis InDesign, Premiere Pro, Acrobat Pro, Photoshop och Illustrator.
* Utmärkta språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.


För att trivas med anställningen bör du stimuleras av att ha flera kontaktytor, uppdrag och arbetsuppgifter pågående samtidigt. Du ska ha lätt för att samarbeta, ha god initiativ- och planeringsförmåga, kunna prioritera bland arbetsuppgifter samt förmåga att arbeta självständigt och ta eget ansvar för ditt arbete. Du är kreativ och kommer med egna idéer och angreppssätt i kommunikationsrelaterade frågor och har förmågan att ta initiativ till utveckling och uppnå resultat.

**Meriterande**

* Erfarenhet av att ta fram kommunikations- och kanalstrategier.
* Arbetat professionellt med sociala medier som t.ex LinkedIn.
* Erfarenhet av kommunikationsarbete i statlig verksamhet, gärna universitet eller högskola.

**Ansökan**


Ansökan ska innehålla ett personligt brev med motivering till varför du söker anställningen, ett CV, relevanta intyg och betyg samt namn och kontaktinformation till minst två referenspersoner.


Ansökan ska vara inkommen via vårt e-rekryteringssystem Varbi senast den 28 september, 2026

**Villkor**


Anställningen avser heltid tillsvidare med tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

**Information**


Närmare upplysningar lämnas av Administrativ chef Rosita Lundberg; tfn: 090-7865969 eller e-post: rosita.lundberg@umu.se

  

Umeå universitet vill erbjuda en jämställd och jämlik miljö där öppna samtal mellan människor med olika bakgrund och perspektiv lägger grunden för lärande, skaparkraft och utveckling. Vi välkomnar därför personer med olika bakgrunder och erfarenheter att söka den aktuella anställningen.Till bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare: Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

title: Senior Finance Controller i Stockholm!
description:
Är du en erfaren Finance Controller eller Senior Accountant som trivs i en dynamisk miljö där redovisning, finansiell kontroll och utveckling går hand i hand? Vill du ta en nyckelroll i en internationell industriverksamhet där du får möjlighet att påverka både processer och arbetssätt?
  
Vi söker nu en Finance Controller / Senior Accountant för ett längre heltidsuppdrag i Stockholm. Här får du en bred och verksamhetsnära roll med stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att bidra med din kompetens i en organisation under utveckling
  
Om rollen
  
I rollen kombinerar du kvalificerad redovisning och Financial Control med processutveckling och ERP-implementering. Du arbetar hands-on med den löpande ekonomin samtidigt som du bidrar till att utveckla strukturer, interna kontroller och effektiva finansiella processer.
  
Du kommer att ha många kontaktytor och samarbeta med stakeholders från olika delar av organisationen.
  
Exempel på arbetsuppgifter
  
Ansvara för löpande redovisning och månadsbokslut
  
  

Genomföra balans- och intercompany-avstämningar
  
  

Hantera momsrapportering
  
  

Arbeta med CAPEX, anläggningstillgångar och redovisningsklassificering
  
  

Bidra i implementering och utveckling av ERP-system
  
  

Utveckla och dokumentera finansiella processer och interna kontroller
  
  

Stötta vid revision och lagstadgad rapportering
  
  

Samarbeta tvärfunktionellt med olika delar av verksamheten
  
  

Vi söker dig som har
  
Du har minst 10 års relevant erfarenhet inom redovisning, Financial Control eller liknande kvalificerad finansroll. Du har en gedigen redovisningsbakgrund och känner dig trygg med att självständigt hantera komplexa ekonomiska frågeställningar.
  
  

**För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:**  

Mycket god kunskap om svensk redovisning och K3
  
  

Praktisk erfarenhet av avstämningar, intercompany, moms, CAPEX och anläggningstillgångar
  
  

Erfarenhet från industriell verksamhet, gärna produktion, lager eller logistik
  
  

Erfarenhet av ERP-implementering, där SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud är särskilt meriterande
  
  

Mycket god engelska i både tal och skrift
  
  

Vem är du?
  
Vi tror att du är strukturerad, proaktiv och lösningsorienterad och uppskattar en miljö där förändring och utveckling är en naturlig del av vardagen.
  
Du har ett öga för detaljer samtidigt som du kan lyfta blicken och förstå helheten. Du tar gärna egna initiativ, driver frågor framåt och trivs i en roll där du får kombinera din finansiella expertis med förbättringsarbete och samarbete över funktionsgränser.
  
Praktisk information
  
**Placeringsort:** Stockholm ⏰ Omfattning: Heltid, 100 % Uppdragsperiod: 6 oktober 2026 – 30 juni 2027 Sista ansökningsdag: 24 september 2026
  
Redo för nästa utmaning? Ta chansen att kliva in i ett spännande uppdrag där din erfarenhet inom Finance Control och redovisning får göra verklig skillnad. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!
  
Sway Sourcing är en innovativ rekryteringspartner som specialiserar sig på att matcha rätt talang med rätt företag – snabbt och effektivt. Vårt huvudfokus ligger inom Ekonomi, Administration, HR, Marknad och IT, men vi har även den breda expertis och flexibilitet som krävs för att leverera skräddarsydda rekryteringslösningar inom alla branscher.
  
Trots att vi är en relativt ny aktör har vi redan byggt förtroende hos många av Sveriges största företag och arbetar både nationellt och internationellt. Med baser i Sverige och Spanien erbjuder vi en unik kombination av lokal expertis och global räckvidd. Vårt starka nätverk och djupa branschinsikter gör oss till en självklar partner för företag som vill ligga steget före i sin rekrytering.

title: Account Manager
description:

**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

Tänk dig ett jobb där du får utvecklas inom B2B-försäljning, träffa nya människor varje dag och driva hela säljresan – från prospektering och mötesbokning till behovsanalys, presentation av lösningar och avslut. Om du gillar ansvar, variation och möjligheten att växa i din karriär så är det här platsen för dig


**Om rollen**



Som Account Manager blir du en viktig del av vårt energifyllda säljteam som arbetar med små och medelstora företag. Du ansvarar för hela säljresan – från att prospektera nya kunder och boka möten, till att genomföra behovsanalyser, presentera skräddarsydda lösningar och stänga affären. Du får möjlighet att utveckla dina försäljningsfärdigheter i praktiken, arbeta målmedvetet med nykundsbearbetning och bygga långsiktiga relationer med både kunder och samarbetspartners.  

  

Initialt ligger fokus på nykundsbearbetning och prospektering, där du får möjlighet att bygga upp din egen kundportfölj från grunden. Du driver själv din försäljning framåt, skapar nya relationer och lägger grunden för långsiktiga affärer och din fortsatta utveckling i rollen.



Du trivs i ett öppet kontorslandskap med högt tempo och energi, tar gärna för dig och driver din egen utveckling framåt.  

  

Hos oss driver du dina egna affärer, men du har alltid teamet i ryggen – här hjälps vi åt, stöttar varandra och firar våra framgångar tillsammans. Du arbetar proaktivt med pipelinehantering och affärsutveckling, och får samtidigt växa i rollen med stöd och inspiration från erfarna kollegor. Hos oss är det högt tempo med högt i tak, men också nära till skratt.



Tjänsten utgår från vårt huvudkontor i Stockholm med Avicii Arena som granne och vår egen 3Arena runt hörnet, där möjligheter till kreativa samarbeten aldrig är långt borta.


**Du kan se fram emot att**


* utveckla dina försäljningsfärdigheter med ansvar för hela säljprocessen, från prospektering till avslut
* Bli en del av en fartfylld miljö där du utvecklas genom kalla samtal, skapar nya affärer och bygger långsiktiga relationer som gör skillnad på riktigt.
* vara en del av att leverera kritisk infrastruktur och bidra direkt till samhällsnyttan
* vara en del av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser enligt Great Place To Work samt att vi är stolt samarbetspartner till Women in Tech och Tjejer Kodar


**Såhär beskriver rekryterande chef Sueb sitt ledarskap:**

  


Jag tror på tydlighet, samarbete och att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för att lyckas tillsammans. För mig är det viktigt att vi har en gemensam förståelse för vad vi ska åstadkomma, varför det är viktigt och hur vi tar oss framåt. Min roll är att stötta, vägleda och uppmuntra längs vägen. Det jag önskar i gengäld är ett engagemang, en vilja att utvecklas och att bidra till teamets gemensamma mål. Jag vill skapa en arbetsplats där vi trivs, har roligt tillsammans och känner stolthet över det vi åstadkommer som lag.

-----------------------------

Julia Maxén
Gruppchef
*"Jag vill att mitt team ska få de bästa förutsättningarna för att göra sitt jobb på bästa sätt. Det är så vi utvecklar oss som team, men även utvecklar Tre framåt."*
Henrik Sundvall
Digital projektledare
*"Det absolut bästa med att vara projektledare på Tre är jag får jobba brett med kollegor från alla delar av organisationen och få lära mig nya saker varje dag. Jag har friheten att vara mig själv – och bli uppskattad för det!"*
Jayasri Battola
Utvecklare
*"The great work culture and the technology made me choose Tre. Working alongside great people in mixed team setups, with both experienced and new talents, along with the latest and greatest tools and technologies like Cloud and Azure."*
**Kvalifikationer**
-------------------

**Vem är du?**



Du är nyfiken, social och gillar att bygga relationer. Du får energi av att förstå människors och företags behov. Vi ser gärna att du har 1–2 års erfarenhet av B2B-försäljning. Du är välbevandrad inom telekombranschen, IT eller liknande, och van att arbeta målstyrt och strukturerat. Du är trygg i att driva hela säljprocessen självständigt där nykundsbearbetning och prospektering är en naturlig del av din säljvardag och du har god digital kompetens.



Här får du en arbetsplats där människor får vara sig själva, där olikheter ses som en styrka och där vi aktivt arbetar för jämställdhet och inkludering. Vill du vara med på vår resa och forma framtidens företagsaffärer med oss?



Rollen innebär resor med övernattning, B-körkort är ett krav.  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**



Vi tar emot ansökningar via denna annons och kommer hålla intervjuer löpande. Personligt brev behövs inte, men vi vill gärna att du bifogar CV och svarar på de frågor vi ställt nedan i samband med att du söker. Vi använder tester för att säkra objektiva bedömningar i samband med urval. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Bakgrundskontroll görs på slutkandidat.

title: Data Center Engineering Technician, DCEO
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  

  

We are currently seeking a Data Center Engineering Operations Technician to serve as a technical resource within our mission critical Data Center’s. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of Data Center Engineering Operations. We strive towards building a diverse workforce and look to hire the best people we can regardless of age, gender or ethnicity.  

  

Due to the success of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) operations and rapid expansion of Data Centers we are recruiting suitable candidates to operate/maintain these facilities in Sweden. In this role you will have a positive involvement in both the maintenance of facilities and the improvement of efficiencies to help offer Amazon customer’s better value.  

  

  

  

Key job responsibilities  

You will also be involved in:  

o Assisting in the operation and maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety equipment and HVAC equipment within the Data Center/Facility. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.  

o Assisting in the maintenance and monitoring of all Data Center systems to include incidents/events, problems, changes, monitoring, problem escalation/notification/resolution and all other aspects of Data Center support.  

o Monitoring and troubleshooting all mechanical, electrical, HVAC systems, voice/data, cooling systems, fire/life safety equipment and generators.  

o Providing assistance to contractor or data center engineers to ensure proper operation and maintenance of all facility equipment.  

o Providing assistance to contractors or data center engineers to deploy new equipment, such as building racks, cabling, and other tasks as necessary.  

o Performing site walk throughs to verify proper operation of Facility Equipment and Monitoring Systems.  

  

In addition to acting as a Facilities First Responder to critical events, you will be a part of the team supporting new data center facilities and existing data center facilities!  

  

A day in the life  

Day to day activities for this role include;
  

o Monitoring of all alarms and systems involved in the operation of power, cooling and fire suppression systems in the data center.
  

o Planning and coordinating vendor works on site to ensure equipment is maintained and uptime retained.
  

o Supporting other sites and teams during events and planned works.
  

o Carrying out rack power up and installation duties.
  

o Monitoring and facilitating new equipment handover.
  

o Supporting new hires and team members through knowledge share and development.
  

o Event response and drill participation.  

  

  

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship & Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1 to 4 years of electrical, mechanical and/or controls relevant experience (degree or trade qualification preferred) with demonstrated key electrical and mechanical competencies and theory.
* Ability to follow procedures system documentation and track issues through appropriate entries into a Trouble Ticket system and apply safe electrical practice according to guidelines set by relevant electrical safety supervisory bodies, while maintaining service level agreements (SLAs) through the implementation of proactive issue detection and immediate response.
* Competent in use of basic IT programs such as MS Word/Excel or similar; Valid driving license and able to cover a 24x7 shift rotation.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Heavy industry or data center experience.
* Working knowledge of generic mechanical-room infrastructure such as chillers, Air Handling Units, and fan controls.
* Working knowledge of backup generator systems.

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Senior Finance Controller i Stockholm!
description:
Är du en erfaren Finance Controller eller Senior Accountant som trivs i en dynamisk miljö där redovisning, finansiell kontroll och utveckling går hand i hand? Vill du ta en nyckelroll i en internationell industriverksamhet där du får möjlighet att påverka både processer och arbetssätt?


Vi söker nu en Finance Controller / Senior Accountant för ett längre heltidsuppdrag i Stockholm. Här får du en bred och verksamhetsnära roll med stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att bidra med din kompetens i en organisation under utveckling

### **Om rollen**


I rollen kombinerar du kvalificerad redovisning och Financial Control med processutveckling och ERP-implementering. Du arbetar hands-on med den löpande ekonomin samtidigt som du bidrar till att utveckla strukturer, interna kontroller och effektiva finansiella processer.


Du kommer att ha många kontaktytor och samarbeta med stakeholders från olika delar av organisationen.

### **Exempel på arbetsuppgifter**

* Ansvara för löpande redovisning och månadsbokslut
* Genomföra balans- och intercompany-avstämningar
* Hantera momsrapportering
* Arbeta med CAPEX, anläggningstillgångar och redovisningsklassificering
* Bidra i implementering och utveckling av ERP-system
* Utveckla och dokumentera finansiella processer och interna kontroller
* Stötta vid revision och lagstadgad rapportering
* Samarbeta tvärfunktionellt med olika delar av verksamheten

### **Vi söker dig som har**


Du har **minst 10 års relevant erfarenhet** inom redovisning, Financial Control eller liknande kvalificerad finansroll. Du har en gedigen redovisningsbakgrund och känner dig trygg med att självständigt hantera komplexa ekonomiska frågeställningar.

**För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:**

* Mycket god kunskap om svensk redovisning och K3
* Praktisk erfarenhet av avstämningar, intercompany, moms, CAPEX och anläggningstillgångar
* Erfarenhet från industriell verksamhet, gärna produktion, lager eller logistik
* Erfarenhet av ERP-implementering, där SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud är särskilt meriterande
* Mycket god engelska i både tal och skrift

### **Vem är du?**


Vi tror att du är **strukturerad, proaktiv och lösningsorienterad** och uppskattar en miljö där förändring och utveckling är en naturlig del av vardagen.


Du har ett öga för detaljer samtidigt som du kan lyfta blicken och förstå helheten. Du tar gärna egna initiativ, driver frågor framåt och trivs i en roll där du får kombinera din finansiella expertis med förbättringsarbete och samarbete över funktionsgränser.

### **Praktisk information**


**Placeringsort:** Stockholm  

**Omfattning:** Heltid, 100 %  

**Uppdragsperiod:** 6 oktober 2026 – 30 juni 2027  

**Sista ansökningsdag:** 24 september 2026

**Redo för nästa utmaning?**
  

Ta chansen att kliva in i ett spännande uppdrag där din erfarenhet inom Finance Control och redovisning får göra verklig skillnad. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!


Sway Sourcing är en innovativ rekryteringspartner som specialiserar sig på att matcha rätt talang med rätt företag – snabbt och effektivt. Vårt huvudfokus ligger inom Ekonomi, Administration, HR, Marknad och IT, men vi har även den breda expertis och flexibilitet som krävs för att leverera skräddarsydda rekryteringslösningar inom alla branscher.


Trots att vi är en relativt ny aktör har vi redan byggt förtroende hos många av Sveriges största företag och arbetar både nationellt och internationellt. Med baser i Sverige och Spanien erbjuder vi en unik kombination av lokal expertis och global räckvidd. Vårt starka nätverk och djupa branschinsikter gör oss till en självklar partner för företag som vill ligga steget före i sin rekrytering.

title: Full-stack Engineer
description:
About the Role
  
We are looking for an experienced Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our engineering team and build modern, scalable, AI-enabled digital products.
  
You will work across the full application stack, from backend services and APIs to modern web interfaces, cloud infrastructure, data integrations, and AI-powered features.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications and enterprise platforms.
  
Build backend services and APIs using technologies such as Java / Spring Boot and Python / FastAPI.
  
Develop modern web applications using React, TypeScript, and Next.js.
  
Design and implement REST, GraphQL, webhook, and third-party API integrations.
  
Build and maintain distributed systems based on microservices and event-driven architectures.
  
Design reliable data models and optimize application and database performance.
  
Develop cloud-native applications and services running on public cloud platforms.
  
Work with relational, NoSQL, caching, and analytical databases.
  
Implement asynchronous processing, messaging, retry mechanisms, idempotency, and failure handling.
  
Build automated CI/CD pipelines and participate in deployment and infrastructure automation.
  
Improve application observability through logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and operational dashboards.
  
Troubleshoot complex application, integration, and production issues across frontend, backend, and cloud environments.
  
Participate in architecture discussions, technical design, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
  
Take ownership of solutions from requirement analysis through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
  
  

AI & Intelligent Application Development
  
As AI becomes increasingly integrated into modern software products, this role also requires practical experience using AI technologies in application development.
  
  

**You will:**  

Design and integrate LLM-powered features into production applications.
  
Integrate APIs from providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or equivalent platforms.
  
Build applications capable of working with multiple AI model providers.
  
Develop AI-enabled workflows for tasks such as content processing, translation, summarization, information extraction, classification, and automation.
  
Implement structured LLM outputs and integrate AI results into backend business logic.
  
Work with model routing, fallback strategies, usage monitoring, and AI API cost management.
  
Build internal engineering tools using AI-assisted development technologies.
  
Explore and implement MCP-based integrations, AI agents, tool calling, and AI-assisted workflows where appropriate.
  
Evaluate AI output quality, reliability, latency, and cost before introducing AI functionality into production systems.
  
Apply appropriate security, privacy, and data handling principles when integrating external AI services.
  
  

Required Qualifications
  
Several years of professional experience as a Full-Stack Engineer, Software Engineer, or similar role.
  
Strong backend development experience with Java and Spring Boot, Python, or comparable backend technologies.
  
Strong frontend development experience with React and TypeScript.
  
Experience designing and developing REST APIs and integrating third-party systems.
  
Solid understanding of microservices and distributed systems.
  
Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle.
  
Experience with NoSQL or caching technologies such as MongoDB and Redis.
  
Experience working with Docker and cloud-based application deployment.
  
Experience with at least one major cloud platform, preferably GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  
Good understanding of software architecture, scalability, performance optimization, and system reliability.
  
Experience with CI/CD and modern software development workflows.
  
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
  
Comfortable taking ownership across frontend, backend, integration, and deployment.
  
Professional working proficiency in English.
  
  

AI Requirements
  
Hands-on experience integrating LLMs or generative AI APIs into applications.
  
Experience using at least one major LLM platform such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or equivalent.
  
Understanding of prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling, and AI API integration patterns.
  
Experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar tools in professional software development.
  
Ability to identify where AI provides business value and where conventional software logic is more appropriate.
  
  

**Understanding of key production AI considerations including:**  

model quality
  
hallucination and reliability
  
latency
  
token usage and cost
  
privacy and data security
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
Experience in one or several of the following areas is considered an advantage:
  
Python FastAPI.
  
React 18/19, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, or modern frontend frameworks.
  
GraphQL.
  
GCP technologies such as Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, and GCS.
  
Event-driven architectures and message-based processing.
  
Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code technologies.
  
Redis, MongoDB, BigQuery, or other modern data platforms.
  
E-commerce, IoT, telecom, or enterprise platform development.
  
High-volume or high-concurrency distributed systems.
  
AI model gateways or abstraction layers such as LiteLLM.
  
Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  
AI Agents and tool-calling architectures.
  
AI observability, model evaluation, cost tracking, or multi-model routing.
  
Building internal developer tools or engineering automation using AI.
  
  

Personal Qualities
  
  

**We believe you are:**  

Product-minded and capable of understanding both technical and business requirements.
  
Comfortable working across the entire software stack.
  
Curious about AI and emerging software technologies.
  
Pragmatic when deciding between AI-based solutions and traditional software engineering.
  
Proactive and comfortable taking ownership of complex technical problems.
  
Structured and analytical when troubleshooting distributed systems.
  
Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders.
  
  

Technology Environment
  
Depending on the project, the technology environment may include:
  
Java · Spring Boot · Python · FastAPI · React · TypeScript · Next.js · REST · GraphQL · PostgreSQL · MongoDB · Redis · BigQuery · Docker · GCP · AWS · Azure · Terraform · Pub/Sub · CI/CD · OpenAI · Claude · Gemini · LiteLLM · MCP · RAG · AI Agents
  
Location
  
Gothenburg
  
Employment
  
Full-time
  
Öppen för alla
  
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

description:
**Votre mission**
-----------------


***At FDJ UNITED, we don't just follow the game, we reinvent it.***

*FDJ UNITED is one of Europe’s leading betting and gaming operators, with a vast portfolio of iconic brands and a reputation for technological excellence. With more than 5,000 employees and a presence in around fifteen regulated markets, the Group offers a diversified, responsible range of games, both under exclusive rights and open to competition. We set new standards, proving that entertainment and safety can go hand in hand. Here, you’ll work alongside a team of passionate individuals dedicated to delivering the best and safest entertaining experiences for our customers every day.*  

  

*We’re looking for bold people who are eager to succeed and ready to level-up the game. If you thrive on innovation, embrace challenges, and want to make a real impact at all levels, FDJ UNITED is your playing field.*

***Join us in shaping the future of gaming. Are you ready to LEVEL-UP THE GAME?***


We are looking for a talented and driven Site Reliability Engineer (Observability Engineer) to join our team and play a key role in building the next generation of our high-performance observability framework.  

  

In this role, you will be at the heart of designing, developing, and operating the systems that give our engineering organisation deep visibility into the health, performance, and reliability of our products and infrastructure. You will work closely with engineering teams across the business to ensure our observability stack is scalable, reliable, and fit for purpose in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment.  

  

The current focus of the framework is built around VictoriaLogs and VictoriaMetrics, with a strong emphasis on OpenTelemetry for metrics and log ingestion. You will help shape how this framework evolves and be a hands-on contributor to its ongoing development, as well as help maintain this in a high traffic production site.**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Designing and developing a next-generation, high-performance observability platform using modern tooling and best practices.
* Driving the adoption and implementation of OpenTelemetry (OTEL/OTLP) for metrics and log ingestion across the organisation.
* Building and maintaining Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management pipelines to automate platform operations.
* Contributing to CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows to support continuous delivery of observability components.
* Owning and improving the reliability, scalability, and performance of the observability stack.
* Collaborating with engineering teams to define and track Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and establish reliability standards.
* Participating in code reviews, architectural discussions, and technical planning sessions.
* Supporting capacity planning, release processes, and change management practices.
* Championing an automation-first mindset and contributing to a culture of operational excellence.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Infrastructure & Configuration Management**

* Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code, specifically Terraform
* Configuration management experience using Ansible and/or Chef

### **Coding Skills**

* Strong scripting and development capabilities in Bash, Python, and Go
* Experience with Rust and/or Java is a nice to have

### **CI/CD & Version Control**

* Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Git and GitLab
* Experience with ArgoCD and/or Jenkins for CI/CD pipeline management

### **Monitoring & Observability**

* Metrics platforms: Prometheus, Mimir, InfluxDB, VictoriaMetrics
* Log aggregation: Splunk, Loki, Elasticsearch, VictoriaLogs
* Visualisation: Grafana
* Log forwarding: FluentBit, Vector.dev
* OpenTelemetry (OTEL/OTLP): Metrics and log pipeline experience

### **Containers & Orchestration**

* Strong experience with Docker and/or Podman
* Kubernetes (including workload management and cluster operations)
* Helm for Kubernetes package management

### **Cloud**

* Hands-on experience with AWS

### **Core Concepts & Principles**


You'll need a solid understanding and proven experience of the following:

* Systems Architecture: ability to design and reason about complex distributed systems
* Networking principles: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, proxies, and beyond
* TSDB (Time Series Database) principles: understanding of storage, retention, cardinality, and query patterns
* Logging principles: structured logging, log pipelines, and log management at scale
* Messaging queues: pub/sub patterns, event-driven architectures
* Clustering principles: high availability, fault tolerance, distributed coordination
* Load balancing: strategies, implementations, and traffic management
* API / JSON principles: RESTful APIs, data serialisation, and integration patterns
* Caching mechanisms: In-memory caching, external caches, and cache invalidation strategies
* Code reviews: Contributing to and leading thoughtful, constructive reviews
* Testing and documentation: Writing quality tests and clear technical documentation
* Agile mindset: Comfortable working in iterative, collaborative delivery environments
* Automation mindset: Defaulting to automation and repeatability in everything you build

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with AI concepts and tooling, including the creation of MCP's and agent Skills
* Microservices architecture: Design patterns, service meshes, inter-service communication

### **Operational Experience**

* Change Management: Structured approaches to managing infrastructure and service changes
* Service Level Indicators (SLIs): Defining, measuring, and acting on reliability metrics
* Capacity Planning: Forecasting infrastructure needs based on usage trends and growth
* Release Processes: Experience with progressive delivery, feature flags, and rollback strategies


We believe talent knows no boundaries. Our hiring process focuses solely on your skills, experience, and potential to contribute to our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and evaluate each candidate based on merit, regardless of personal characteristics as the age, gender, origin, religion, sexual orientation, neurodiversity or disability.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.


**Your role**


We are now looking for AI Engineers to scale our Data & AI Capabilities within the Engineering Practices of Capgemini. You will be part of a diverse and inclusive team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and Software Engineers, working on a variety of Client Challenges within the Automotive, Manufacturing, Life Science, Defence and Retail Industries.


You will deliver value to Nordic clients through senior-level assignments, contribute to solution design and presales activities, and act as a Subject Matter Expert in Data, AI & ML. Collaboration with other engineering practices to optimize operations is key.


*In this role you will play a key role in:*


* Lead client projects and provide technical expertise.
* Support presales and solution architecture discussions.
* Represent the organization as a thought leader in Data, AI & ML.
* Collaborate across engineering domains to implement data-driven optimizations.
* Design and own end-to-end AI solutions, from data pipelines to deployment, monitoring, and governance.
* Build and evolve MLOps and CI/CD capabilities for automated model deployment and lifecycle management.
* Define architecture standards and security controls for Generative AI, LLM, and RAG solutions.

**Your profile**


* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Biology, Engineering, or a related field, with 5+ years of relevant industry experience.
* Strong programming and analytics expertise in Python, R, C++, and statistical data analysis.
* Hands-on experience with SQL, Elasticsearch, Databricks, Snowflake, and large-scale data pipelines using Spark, PySpark, Kafka, and Hadoop.
* Proficiency with ML and AI technologies, including PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, and OpenAI Agents SDK.
* Deep understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, MCP-based agentic workflows, ETL processes on cloud platforms, and the ability to collaborate effectively with external technology stakeholders.

We value flexibility to adapt in high-paced working environments. Ability to lead own tasks and coordinate others. Excellent English communication skills, both writing and speaking. We are reviewing candidates continuously and will be flexible to discuss contracts with later start dates. Most of our clients are based in Gothenburg; however, we do have opportunities in other locations. * Experience with requirements analysis and high- and low-level solution design.

title: Head of Data, Analytics and AI
description:
**Looking for a workplace for the future?**  

At Telenor, you own your career. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make the most of your dreams and expertise while contributing to technological innovations that are barely even imagined today. Innovations that we know will change the map for how we communicate and live our connected lives in the future. Are you looking for a workplace where you can make a difference in what matters most – relationships between people? Then you are welcome to Telenor.

**How you'll make a difference with us**


Telenor Sweden is on an exciting journey rebuilding a fragmented data landscape into a cloud-native foundation and moving from AI experimentation to adoption across the company.


In this role, you will lead our Analytics, Data Management, Automation & AI organisation, consisting of approximately 50 employees and consultants across data engineering, analytics, business intelligence, data platforms, architecture, marketing technology, AI and automation. You will have three leaders reporting to you, own a budget of approximately 90 MSEK, report to the CIO and be part of the IT Management Team.


The department has been on a transformation journey for several years. The next step is about turning investments in data, AI and automation into measurable business value. You will play a key role in connecting technology, people and business outcomes while building the capabilities needed for the future.

**What success looks like**


Rather than list everything you will be responsible for, here is what we want to be true 18 months in:

* AI and automation solutions are running in production with clear ownership, monitoring and lifecycle management
* Investments in data and AI are followed up based on adoption and business outcomes, with AI, analytics and automation delivering measurable commercial value.
* Data and AI capabilities are broadly adopted across the organisation, supported by strong data governance, responsible AI practices, self-service analytics and increased AI literacy.
* Legacy platforms have been decommissioned and core data assets migrated to our GCP-based data foundation.
* You have continued to develop an engaged, high-performing organisation with the competence and capabilities needed for the future.

**Are you the one we're looking for?**


We are looking for a strategic and business-oriented technology leader who combines strong leadership with deep knowledge of data, analytics and AI.


To be clear, this is a leadership role in a technical domain, not a technical role with people attached. You need enough depth to make sound calls on architecture, investment and risk, but leading people, driving change and connecting technology to business outcomes matters just as much.

**Five things. If you bring these, we would like to talk to you.**

* You have led a data, analytics or AI organisation and defined enterprise-wide direction, turning strategy into roadmaps, priorities and trade-offs that people can act on, including influencing senior leaders on investments and priorities.
* You have taken data or AI initiatives from proof of concept through to production, adoption and measurable value at scale, including leading the change work required across multiple business functions, leveraging strong business acumen to align technology investments with strategic priorities and serving as a trusted advisor to leaders on data, AI and transformation opportunities.
* You have modernised a complex data landscape, moving from legacy platforms to scalable cloud architecture.
* You know modern cloud data architecture, AI and Generative AI, particularly cloud data and AI environments such as GCP, BigQuery and Vertex AI, well enough to make good calls. You also know what responsible AI requires in practice: governance, transparency, privacy, data quality, model risk management and regulatory compliance.
* You have owned budgets and investment portfolios, including CAPEX and OPEX planning, forecasting, prioritisation and financial follow-up, and led vendor and partner ecosystems, including build, buy or partner decisions and strategic technology partnerships.


If you recognise yourself in most of this, but not all of it, apply anyway and tell us how you would close the gap.


Experience from telecommunications or another data-intensive and regulated industry is an advantage, as is exposure to MLOps, intelligent automation or enterprise-wide AI governance. We also see experience from Nordic or international organisations as valuable. Swedish is not required, as our working language is English, although Swedish language skills would be beneficial for effective stakeholder management and communication across the organisation.


Most importantly, you bring a strong business mindset and understand how data, analytics and AI create value. Whether gained through hands-on work with analytics, commercial initiatives or business transformation, you know how to translate customer and business needs into insights, decisions and measurable outcomes.

**How you lead**


You make complexity manageable. You set a clear direction so people know what matters most and why — and you build strong leaders around you who can act on it without waiting for permission.


You are as comfortable in a technical discussion as in a business one, and you move easily between them. Complex topics become choices people understand and want to be part of. You question how things are done when it's needed, but you bring people with you rather than leaving them behind.


And when priorities compete and everything depends on everything else, you're the one who creates focus. You make the trade-offs, explain the thinking behind them, and keep the organisation moving.

**Our promise to you**

*We are better together.*  

Here, you’ll be part of a family-like and inclusive culture, built on strong shared values and leadership that empowers you with both trust and confidence. We believe in enabling each other to act and make decisions, while always having each other’s backs through ups and downs.

*We support relationships and societies.*  

Telenor plays a vital role in the society, giving your work a greater purpose. Every day, we create value for millions of people and maintain a customer-first approach where human relationships are at the heart of everything we do.

*We make room for life.*  

Work from home up to two days a week, if your role allows it. The rest of the time, we create magic together at the office. Leadership based on trust and flexible working hours helps you balance work and life. We support you through every stage of life with our benefit package, including collective agreements, occupational pensions, wellness allowances, and customized insurance solutions tailored to your needs.

*We invite you to a career in motion.*  

Your development is at the center of our culture. We dedicate at least 40 hours per year for you to deepen your expertise, explore new areas, and develop in your role. Through Telenor Academy and other learning initiatives, you’ll have the tools and freedom to advance your career. If you want to broaden your horizons, we are present throughout the Nordics.

**Apply today!**


Will you take the next step in your career with us? We look forward to your application! We review applicants on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait—reach out today.


If you have any questions or want to know more, feel free to contact the hiring manager Kristin Lindmark at Kristin.lindmark@telenor.se. Please note that we cannot accept applications via email.

**Good to know**


As part of Telenor’s policy, we conduct background checks on final candidates for all recruitments.

description:

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.


**Your role**
  

As a Cyber Security Architect, you will take part in complex large-scale projects focused on the design, planning, and building of Telecom Infrastructures and Networks, enabling a wide range of use-cases such as Mission Critical Communications (post Tetra), Public Safety, Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) and Industrial IoT.


*In this role you will play a key role in:*
  

* Design of end-to-end security architecture for Cloud and Telecom Infrastructures environments, covering the following domains: SIM/eSIM, Devices, RAN, Transport (MPLS/IP), EPC and 5G Core, IMS, MCx, OSS, and BSS.
* Develop security frameworks aligned with international standards (e.g., 3GPP, GSMA, ETSI, NIST, ISO 27001, etc.), best practices (e.g., defense in depth, zero trust, adaptive security) and organizational security policies.
* Conduct risk assessments and threat modeling for Telecom environments.
* Provide technical expert guidance to mitigate cyber security risks, vulnerabilities, weaknesses and incidents affecting the telecom environment.
* Assess and recommend security technologies (e.g., Firewalls, IDS/IPS, Encryption, PKI, HSM, PAM, EDR, SIEM, SOAR, etc.) and validate vendor solutions against security requirements.
* Lead and/or collaborate with solution architects and integration teams to ensure secure deployments.

**Your profile**
  

* Master’s degree in computer science, information security, or telecommunications.
* Min 10 years of experience in cyber security, including minimum of 5 years in Telecom environments.
* Certifications: TOGAF, ISSAP, CISSP, CCSP or equivalent.

Technical Skills:

title: Kommunikatör
description:
Tjänsten är placerad inom förvaltningen Verksamhetsstöd och service som är en av åtta förvaltningar i Linköpings kommun. Inom förvaltningen finns kommunens interna tjänster och servicefunktioner samlade. Vi bidrar till utveckling av kommunens verksamheter och kommunövergripande servicelösningar.

  


**Information om tjänsten**
---------------------------


**Sista ansökningsdag:** 20 september 2026
**Referensnummer:** 17767
**Anställningsform:** Tillsvidareanställning  

*Vill du förgylla vardagen och förbättra livskvaliteten för Linköpingsborna? Hos oss kan du göra en viktig skillnad och bidra till att göra Linköping till en bättre plats. Välkommen till oss!*


**Dina arbetsuppgifter**
------------------------


Som kommunikatör hos oss väntar en omväxlande roll med tyngdpunkt på operativt kommunikationsarbete i digitala kanaler. Ditt uppdrag omfattar att skapa, målgruppsanpassa och publicera innehåll för både intern och extern kommunikation. Du kommer att producera material för sociala medier, där fokus ligger på bild och film, enklare redigering samt inläggstexter. I tjänsten ingår även att skapa, hantera och optimera annonsering i de största sociala mediekanalerna. Vidare är du en naturlig del av vår arbetsvardag genom att arbeta med webb, intranät, nyhetsskrivande, korrekturläsning och att ta fram presentationer.


Du har hela organisationen som ditt arbetsfält, med uppdrag som spänner från enklare reels-produktioner till deltagande i större kommunikationsprojekt. Rollen är utåtriktat och innebär att du ibland åker på besök ute i våra verksamheter för att träffa människor, antingen i sällskap av kollegor eller i mer formella sammanhang med politiker. Då är det du som ansvarar för att fota, filma och samla in material. Rollen innebär också ett stort eget ansvar för att hantera våra betalda kampanjer i sociala medier.


Du ingår regelbundet i olika projektgrupper och nätverk, både inom den egna enheten men även tvärfunktionellt ihop med kollegor på andra förvaltningar.


**Din arbetsplats**
-------------------


Kommunikationsservice är kommunens interna kommunikationsbyrå som erbjuder kommunikationstjänster till kommunens verksamheter och bolag. Här hjälper vi till från idé till färdig produktion. Bland annat inom film, foto och animation, ljudproduktion, grafisk formgivning, e-utbildning, skribentjobb, tillgänglighetsanpassningar av vissa dokument, webbpublicering, webbutbildning och annonsering via sociala medier.


Vi sitter i moderna lokaler i Ebbepark. Vi tillämpar förtroendetid och distansarbete i upp till två dagar i veckan när verksamheten tillåter. Visst arbete kommer att ske på obekväm arbetstid.


**Du som söker**
----------------


Vi söker nu en nyfiken och engagerad kommunikatör. Vi söker dig som har en högskoleexamen inom kommunikation och media, alternativt annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig.


Du som söker har erfarenhet av arbete med kommunikation såväl internt som externt. Vi ser också att du har också erfarenhet av att producera texter och annat innehåll för publicering i digitala kanaler och i sociala medier, såväl som erfarenhet av att publicera och optimera kampanjer i de vanligaste sociala mediekanalerna. Det är också ett krav att du har erfarenhet av film- och ljudproduktion för sociala medier. Du har förmåga att följa en given grafisk profil, samt har kunskap inom Adobe Creative Cloud eller likvärdigt program.


Vidare ser vi gärna att du har erfarenhet av projektledning eller har varit drivande projektdeltagande inom kommunikation. Ett plus är att du tidigare arbetat med strategiskt kommunikationsarbete i en politiskt styrd organisation. Du har med fördel också erfarenhet av kreativ copywriting.


För tjänsten är det ett krav att du har goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift eftersom du kommer att producera material på svenska. Vi ser det som meriterande om du har B-körkort då arbetet innebär resor till olika platser för reportage och inspelningar.


Som kommunikatör är du kvalitetsmedveten och lyhörd för kundens behov. Du blir en utmärkt byggsten i vårt team där tydlighet och kreativitet är viktiga drag hos dig som person. Du har ett förhållningssätt som är serviceinriktat och du trivs med att samarbeta med andra människor. Du lockas av att få hålla på med det du är specialist på, att kommunicera i en verksamhet där du verkligen gör skillnad i vardagen för våra beställare och slutligen våra kommuninvånare.


Befattningen som tjänsten avser kräver även uppvisande av utdrag ur belastningsregistret inför anställning. Beställ ditt utdrag först om du blir kallad på intervju.


**Övrig information**
---------------------


*När du söker en tjänst i Linköpings kommun registrerar du din ansökan genom inloggning via e-legitimation (såsom BankID eller FrejaID) istället för e-postadress. Saknar du e-legitimation? Vänligen kontakta ansvarig HR-konsult eller chef, så hjälper de dig att registrera din ansökan.*

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
**Sambla Group is a fintech company with a clear goal – to be your trusted financial partner. We’ve grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies - bridging the gap between borrowers and lenders - thanks to the 500+ amazing people who work here.**


At Sambla Group, data is central to how we make decisions, build products, and shape business strategy. We are strengthening our Data Platform team and are looking for an **Analytics Engineer** to help design, build, and maintain the analytical foundation used across the organization.


You will join a team of Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers, reporting to the Engineering Manager. This is a technical role focused on building scalable, trusted, and well-documented data products - not one-off reports. You will work with SQL, dbt, semantic models, testing frameworks, cloud data warehouses, and modern analytics practices to ensure that teams across Sambla can confidently use data for analysis, decision-making, and AI-enabled insights.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Analytics Engineering & Data Modeling**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT models using **SQL, dbt, and Git-based workflows**.
* Develop robust transformation layers that turn raw data into trusted, reusable analytical assets.
* Build and own core analytical models, including dimensional models, marts, metric layers, and semantic models.
* Define and maintain standards for naming, documentation, testing, version control, and governance.
* Work closely with Data Engineering to align source data structures with downstream analytical needs.  

  

**Testing, Quality & Governance**
* Implement dbt tests, source freshness checks, data validations, and business logic controls.
* Ensure strong data lineage, documentation, ownership, and discoverability of analytical assets.
* Monitor and improve data quality, reliability, and performance across the analytical stack.
* Promote consistent metric definitions and trusted data products across business domains.  

  

**AI-Enabled Analytics & Self-Service**
* Structure data models and semantic layers so they can support both human analysis and AI-driven analytics.
* Explore how AI can improve analytics workflows, including data discovery, documentation, anomaly detection, and natural language interaction with data.
* Create well-documented, reusable data assets that allow analysts and business users to answer questions with confidence.
* Guide stakeholders on how to use data products effectively and translate business needs into scalable analytical solutions.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data, Analytics, or a related technical field.
* Several years of experience in analytics engineering, data modeling, data transformation, or analytical architecture.
* Expert-level SQL, including optimization, advanced functions, and analytical modeling patterns.  

Strong hands-on experience with **dbt or similar frameworks**, including modeling, testing, documentation, and lineage.
* Experience working with **cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar platforms**.
* Solid understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, semantic modeling, and modern analytics architecture.
* Experience with Git-based workflows, pull requests, code reviews, and CI/CD for analytics assets.
* Strong focus on data quality, testing, maintainability, and scalable analytical design.
* Ability to translate business questions into clear, reusable, and well-modeled data products.  

  

**Nice-to-Have**
* Experience designing semantic layers, metric stores, governed KPI frameworks, or reusable business logic layers.
* Experience with **BI and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik, or similar platforms**.
* Exposure to AI-driven analytics, conversational analytics, natural language querying, or insight-generation platforms.
* Experience using AI tools to support analytics engineering workflows, such as documentation, testing, SQL development, or data discovery.
* Familiarity with orchestration, observability, and data quality tools in the modern data stack.  

  

**You’ll Thrive in This Role If**
* You think in architecture, standards, and systems - not just individual datasets.
* You care deeply about data quality, traceability, and semantic consistency.
* You enjoy building scalable analytical foundations that empower others to work confidently with data.
* You are curious about how AI can improve the way organizations discover, understand, and interact with data.
* You like working closely with users to understand their needs and turn them into robust, reusable data products.

 **We might be a little different from most companies. Instead of defining personal values, we’ve built a shared way of working - a rhythm that guides how we collaborate, support our customers, and move forward together.** **We call it Drive & Jive - a shared rhythm that creates momentum through direction, collaboration, and human connection.**  

  

As part of our recruitment process, we always carry out a background check before extending a job offer.

title: Data Center Technician , DCC Communities
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

We are looking for Data Center Technicians to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team. Data Center Technicians are the primary resolver and troubleshoot and solve a range of datacenter infrastructure issues including, but not limited to: hardware, fiber, networking, and related problems. You will be part of the Data Center Operations (DCO) team, overseeing the operation and maintenance of the IT infrastructure and hardware for data centers in AWS Cloud regions. You will become the primary resolver for your support team, and gain troubleshooting skills on different hardware and software cases. You will be able to troubleshoot and solve most infrastructure issues and engage other appropriate solutions groups on more complex problems to drive solutions..  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* SAFETY

  

Follow and maintain the highest safety standards and diligently encourage a world-class safety culture. Own the safety initiatives and projects to foster a strong safety culture.  

  

* DATA CENTER OPERATIONS (DCO)

  

This position involves:  

* Diagnosing hardware and network problems followed by physical repairs
* Troubleshooting events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Performing root cause analysis of equipment failures
* Manual handling and lifting of equipment may be required (weight limits in accordance with regulations)
* Working rotating shifts (morning/night) as well as weekends to maintain the 24/7 data center environment

  

A valid (EU) driving license is required as Data Centers may not have any public transportation available nearby.  

  

Location Requirements:  

Our data centers are located in remote areas where access via public transport may be limited. Therefore, a valid EU driving license is required for this role.  

  

Work Schedule:  

This is a 100% onsite in-person position due to the hands-on nature of managing mission-critical infrastructure and data center industry.  

  

A day in the life  

In this role, you'll be working on our advanced ticketing system, managing a diverse workload and solving complex server hardware issues.
  

  

You'll be part of a collaborative team that keeps our cloud infrastructure running smoothly, responding to both automated directives and team leadership with exceptional time management and adaptability.  

  

Your expertise in problem ticket tracking and escalation procedures will be crucial as you consistently meet and exceed Amazon's high standards for technical proficiency and operational excellence. This role is vital in maintaining the efficiency and reliability of our sophisticated data center infrastructure – you'll be working and supporting the face of Cloud technology in the region.  

  

We're looking for skilled technicians with a passion for technology to help us expand our Cloud to the next level.
  

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship & Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Basic networking experience.
* Ability to work well with others in a team environment, displaying excellent time management skills.
* Ability to take direction from both a directed work system and/or a team lead.
* Able to lift/move up to 18kg equipment.
* Valid EU driving license.
* 1+ years of technical experience.
* General knowledge of troubleshooting server hardware issues.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with problem ticket tracking, prioritization, and escalation procedures.
* Understanding of maintenance windows/change management procedures.
* Basic understanding of data center facilities.
* Networking administration and/or certification.
* CCENT/CCNA, Network+, A+.

title: Data Center Engineering Technician, DCEO
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  

  

We are currently seeking a Data Center Engineering Operations Technician to serve as a technical resource within our mission critical Data Center’s. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of Data Center Engineering Operations. We strive towards building a diverse workforce and look to hire the best people we can regardless of age, gender or ethnicity.  

  

Due to the success of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) operations and rapid expansion of Data Centers we are recruiting suitable candidates to operate/maintain these facilities in Sweden. In this role you will have a positive involvement in both the maintenance of facilities and the improvement of efficiencies to help offer Amazon customer’s better value.  

  

  

  

Key job responsibilities  

You will also be involved in:  

o Assisting in the operation and maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety equipment and HVAC equipment within the Data Center/Facility. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.  

o Assisting in the maintenance and monitoring of all Data Center systems to include incidents/events, problems, changes, monitoring, problem escalation/notification/resolution and all other aspects of Data Center support.  

o Monitoring and troubleshooting all mechanical, electrical, HVAC systems, voice/data, cooling systems, fire/life safety equipment and generators.  

o Providing assistance to contractor or data center engineers to ensure proper operation and maintenance of all facility equipment.  

o Providing assistance to contractors or data center engineers to deploy new equipment, such as building racks, cabling, and other tasks as necessary.  

o Performing site walk throughs to verify proper operation of Facility Equipment and Monitoring Systems.  

  

In addition to acting as a Facilities First Responder to critical events, you will be a part of the team supporting new data center facilities and existing data center facilities!  

  

A day in the life  

Day to day activities for this role include;
  

o Monitoring of all alarms and systems involved in the operation of power, cooling and fire suppression systems in the data center.
  

o Planning and coordinating vendor works on site to ensure equipment is maintained and uptime retained.
  

o Supporting other sites and teams during events and planned works.
  

o Carrying out rack power up and installation duties.
  

o Monitoring and facilitating new equipment handover.
  

o Supporting new hires and team members through knowledge share and development.
  

o Event response and drill participation.  

  

  

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship & Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
